objectives.text:
Shuffle face down 3 Fake Rings of Arc and 1 Ring of Arc.
The first 4 lead heroes come into play with 1 face-down Ring each.
When a hero with a Ring enters zone 5 or leaves the map, its Ring is revealed.
If the Ring of Arc is in zone 5, you win.
